MovieEditorViewModel does not itself implement IDisposable. If TaggerVm is non-null when MovieEditorViewModel is garbage-collected without LoadAsync being called again, the TaggerViewModel subscription remains until GC collects both. In practice this is a benign GC edge case — the ITagsManager singleton holds a weak reference through the event only if the subscriber is also reachable. However, if stricter lifetime semantics are needed in future, MovieEditorViewModel should also implement IDisposable and call TaggerVm?.Dispose() in its Dispose() method.
